title: What if Backpack Battles had a baby with a farming game? ( Game Jam )
author: barret232hxc
selftext:
That’s **BloomOff** — a September jam game I couldn’t stop working on after the deadline.

The pitch: shop for seeds and gear, pack your garden plot, graft weird combos together, then a \~40second bloom-off against a rival garden. Whoever’s layout grows better wins the round. Rinse, repeat, get weirder plants.

I started wanting something peaceful — cute plants growing, filling the soil, watching the garden come together. Then I needed a reason for the layout to matter, so I borrowed the Backpack Battles loop (shop → arrange → fight) and tried to keep the cozy part: sprouts climbing, synergies lighting up, sky changing as you win.

Honestly I always thought inventory games were boring to watch. This one was built so it’s still fun if you’re just spectating — growth you can see, fast round.

Play free in browser (mobile works as well): [https://run.world/barret/bloomoff](https://run.world/barret/bloomoff)

If you try it, I’d love a honest take: cozy farming or still too fiddly?
